prompt: access.log is a web server log. Find the IP address with the most responses of status 500 and write only that IP to answer.txt.
check: test "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < answer.txt)" = "$(awk '$9 == 500 {print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')"
solution: awk '$9 == 500 {print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' > answer.txt
